messages:
Ava: Kicking off a short thread about an offline / air-gapped bundle for LangChain & LlamaIndex integrations. Goal: SI-friendly artifact for customers with no internet + a marketplace-friendly private listing.
Diego: Love it. Key asks: signed images, SBOM, attestations, and an easy install path (helm + offline bundle). Also need instructions for KMS/HSM integration in private installs.
Mina: From product: include a small sample agent + example that demos streaming + function calling. Also add a 'validate' smoke-test that SIs can run post-install (exit code 0 = pass).
Ava: Proposed contents of offline bundle:
- OCI images (signed) + tarball for registry mirror
- Helm chart + kustomize overlays for private clusters
- CLI: redwood-bundle push/mirror/verify
- sample LangChain adapter (python) and LlamaIndex connector (node)
- SBOM and attestation docs
- perf report and tested HW matrix (A100/H100/amd)
Diego: Implementation notes: use cosign for signing, include cosign public key in the bundle, and provide a script to load images into an air-gapped registry (k3s/eks/aks examples). Also provide an example values.yaml that toggles use of quantized artifacts.
Mina: Quick sample values.yaml snippet:
```yaml
image:
  repository: redwood-offline/tooling-bridge
  tag: 0.2.0-offline
security:
  requireImageSig: true
  cosignPubKey: |
    -----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----\n    MIIBIjANBgkqh...\n    -----END PUBLIC KEY-----
auth:
  kms:
    enabled: true
    provider: aws-kms
    keyRef: projects/example/locations/global/keyRings/k1/cryptoKeys/k2
cache:
  enabled: true
  ttl: 25
```
DeployBot: Build: ghcr.io/redwood-inference/bridgekit:v0.2.0-offline pushed (sha: f00ba7). SBOM generated. Cosign signatures created.
Diego: For marketplace listing: we need a short compliance statement about data handling (no customer data leaves cluster by default), support window for private listing, and a contact alias for SI escalations.
Mina: Also flag: offline customers often want HSM integration. Add KMS/HSM docs + example using PKCS#11 and Azure Key Vault.
Ava: Perf matrix plan: run batch sizes 4/8/16 across 256/512/1024 tokens on A100 and H100, record p95 latencies and tokens/sec. Add a small note about expected degradation when using hostNetworking or small nodes.
Diego: Announcement plan: private marketplace early access next Wed, SI pilot the following week, public co-announcement (with LangChain) in 3 weeks pending co-brand approval. Legal needs co-brand guidelines and a short compatibility matrix for LangChain/LlamaIndex versions supported.
Mina: Action items:
- Diego: mirror scripts + cosign key instructions + registry mirror examples (due Tue)
- Mina: sample app + smoke test + SBOM/attestation docs (due Tue)
- Ava: perf run + HW matrix + marketplace blurb draft (due Wed)
- Clare: reach out to LangChain comms/legal for co-brand signoff (due Mon)
Clare: On it, will ping LangChain and include the compatibility matrix + co-brand checklist.
Ava: Let's use Friday 9am PT to do a final asset check before the marketplace private listing. I'll schedule a 30m slot.
Diego: Fine by me. :thumbsup:
Mina: Works.
DeployBot: CI: offline bundle build succeeded, artifacts: gh-artifacts/bridgekit-offline-0.2.0.tar.gz. Lint: helm OK. Smoke tests pending.
Ava: Thanks all — keeping this tight. I'll drop the draft README into the partners repo and tag @partnerships once it's ready.
